questions.question: On this day in 1449, which founder of the House of Oldenburg was crowned King of Denmark?
questions.explanation: Christian I was crowned monarch of Denmark on 28 October 1449 and went on to rule Norway and Sweden under the Kalmar Union.
questions.context:
On this day in 1449: Christian I is crowned king of Denmark.
Christian I of Denmark (Scandinavian monarch under the Kalmar Union (1426–1481)): Christian I was a German noble and Scandinavian monarch under the Kalmar Union. He was king of Denmark (1448–1481), Norway (1450–1481) and Sweden (1457–1464). From 1460 to 1481, he was also duke of Schleswig and count of Holstein. He was the first king of the House of Oldenburg.

questions.question: Often hailed as the 'Queen of Rap', which Trinidadian performer released the hits 'Super Bass' and 'Starships' under her famous stage name?
questions.explanation: Born Onika Tanya Maraj-Petty in Trinidad, Nicki Minaj is widely referred to as the Queen of Rap.
questions.context: Nicki Minaj (Trinidadian rapper and singer-songwriter (born 1982)): Onika Tanya Maraj-Petty, known professionally as Nicki Minaj, is a Trinidadian rapper, singer, and songwriter. Regarded as the "Queen of Rap" and one of the most influential rappers of all time, she is noted for her dynamic rap flow, witty lyrics, musical versatility, and alter egos, and is credited as a driving force in the mainstream resurgence of female rap since the 2010s.

questions.question: Which Bundesliga club did English striker and national team captain Harry Kane sign for?
questions.explanation: Harry Kane captains England and plays as a forward for German club Bayern Munich.
questions.context: Harry Kane (English footballer (born 1993)): Harry Edward Kane is an English professional footballer who plays as a striker for Bundesliga club Bayern Munich and captains the England national team. Known for his clinical finishing, passing, vision and tactical versatility, he is widely regarded as one of the best players in the world.

questions.question: For his portrayal of which character on the NBC sitcom Friends did Matthew Perry achieve worldwide fame?
questions.explanation: Matthew Perry played the sarcastic Chandler Bing across all ten seasons of Friends from 1994 until 2004.
questions.context: Matthew Perry (American and Canadian actor (1969–2023)): Matthew Langford Perry was an American and Canadian actor. Known primarily for his work in comedy, he gained international fame for starring as Chandler Bing on the NBC television sitcom Friends (1994–2004), receiving his first Primetime Emmy Award nomination in 2002 for the role. Perry also appeared on Ally McBeal (2002), The West Wing (2003) and The Ron Clark Story (2006) receiving Primetime Emmy Award nominations for his performances in the latter two.

questions.question: Before beginning his second stint as President of Brazil in 2023, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva previously led the country across which period?
questions.explanation: Lula da Silva originally served as Brazil's 35th president between 2003 and 2011 before returning to office in 2023.
questions.context: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (President of Brazil (2003–2011; since 2023)): Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, known mononymously as Lula, is a Brazilian politician, trade unionist, and former metalworker who has served as the 39th president of Brazil since 2023. A member of the Workers' Party, he served as the 35th president from 2003 to 2011.
